reader: Claude Opus 5.5, research reader with source
reason: The first reading was already complete and legible; with Morin's text in hand one doubtful word was settled (exuit) and the reread lines were confirmed for collation.
sources: G. Morin, Sancti Caesarii episcopi Arelatensis Opera omnia I (Maredsous, 1937), pp. 562-564, Sermo 144; text read as OCR of the reprint in Patrologiae Latinae Supplementum 4, cols. 397-400, https://archive.org/details/patrologiaecursu0004mign_s6m4; headnote and apparatus as Google Books snippets

A. B. Caillau and M. N. S. Guillon, Collectio selecta SS. Ecclesiae Patrum 23 (Paris, 1836), pp. 324-326, Ps.-Augustine Sermo LXV De poenitentia, page images, https://archive.org/details/collectioselecta0023unse/page/n332/mode/1up
F. Liverani, Spicilegium Liberianum (Florence, 1863), pp. 25-26, Google Books snippets only

Catalogue snippets for the Litany block in homiliaries: Morin I, pp. lxiv, cvii; V. Rose, Verzeichniss der lateinischen Handschriften der Koeniglichen Bibliothek zu Berlin, p. 92; A. M. Bandini, Catalogus codicum Latinorum Bibliothecae Mediceae Laurentianae (1774), p. 403; Catalogus codicum manu scriptorum, Stift Melk (1889), p. 313
text:
F-t273 - SOURCE-ASSISTED reading (made with Morin's text of Caesarius, Sermo 144, in hand, PLS 4 cols. 397-400). A research reader reread on native-size crops, 12 October 2026: recto col. a lines 14-24 and 34-46; verso col. a lines 34-46; verso col. b lines 1-21. All other lines rest on the image-only first reading and are not repeated here. Not an independent reading. Accuracy not measured.
Conventions: (..) = expansion of an abbreviation; / = line end; ? = uncertain; [ ] = note. u/v and i/j as u and i.

    quide(m) agnoscentes crimina sua . recon
    ciliari d(omi)no p(er) penitentia(m) possunt . Nul-
    lus magis de peccatorib(us) plangi dign(us)   ["peccatoribus" rubbed in the middle]
    est . quam qui putat se n(on) habere quod
    plangat . Multa eni(m) delictoru(m) genera
    dil(ectissi)mi . et haec p(er)iculosiora quidem quae
    leuia e(ss)e credunt(ur) . Illa sunt magis no-
    xia que quibusda(m) estimant(ur) non e(ss)e
    peccata . Nullu(m) enim malu(m) facilius de-
    cipit . qua(m) cu(m) non intellegit(ur) malu(m) e(ss)e .
    Itaq(ue) ego nunc dico de homicidiis . n(on)   [no "non" before "dico"]
    de adulteriis . n(on) de malis p(er)suasionibus .
    Absit enim ut xp(ist)ianoru(m) haec aliquis   [last line of column]
